_note: ORPHAN CLASSIFICATION. Every reader-facing entry that mapped to no declared semantic unit, classified by WHY it is unmapped. The prior guard pinned the count at <=96 while the real number is 28 — so 68 new orphans could appear without the guard noticing. Result: ZERO of the 28 is legitimately outside the universe. Every one is either a missing unit (B, E), or a behaviour that belongs to a capability unit (C, D). The universe is therefore materially incomplete and its hash cannot be final.

classes.A: maps to a declared DOMAIN concept unit (excluded upstream by the generator)
classes.B: states a BANZA canonical/normative fact whose authority is real and live but was never enumerated as a universe source — A UNIVERSE GAP, the unit must be added
classes.C: a safety refusal / action-boundary behaviour — belongs to a CAPABILITY unit, not a factual unit
classes.D: a tool-intent detection behaviour — belongs to a CAPABILITY unit
classes.E: REPO truth: describes this repository's own implementation, guards, indexer or CI — real reader-facing knowledge with no PROTOCOL authority, so it needs its own class rather than an exemption
classes.F: stale authority: cites an artifact that no longer exists — must be repaired or retired
classes.G: dead or unreachable: no question routes here — must be deleted
